messages:
Noah Patel: Hi all, second day and ran into an onboarding snag. My laptop courier got delayed. Can I use my personal Mac to clone private repos for initial setup? Don't want to break rules.
Rae (People Ops): Welcome Noah! Short answer: web-only access is fine. For cloning private repos or using VPN we need a loaner or a BYOD waiver + temporary exception. Want me to flag a loaner?
Noah Patel: Yeah request loaner please. Also curious about local dev credentials: can I store SSH keys locally on personal machine with encrypted disk?
Alex (Security): Hey Noah — storing keys on personal devices that sync to cloud is disallowed. If disk is encrypted and keys never leave the device and you sign a BYOD waiver, we can consider a 48h temporary exception, but prefer a company loaner. Also make sure MFA via Okta Verify is set up.
IT-helpdesk: Creating loaner ticket now (IT-4521). We can courier binary tomorrow AM. Loaner will have Jamf enrolled and company certs preinstalled.
Noah Patel: Thanks. Quick Okta question: my phone isn't getting SMS codes in another country. Is Authenticator app allowed?
Alex (Security): Authenticator apps are preferred over SMS. Use Okta Verify or Google Authenticator. If you need a fallback, open a ticket and we can validate identity and enable a temporary backup MFA.
security-bot: Assigned: "Security Essentials (Onboarding)" training — due in 72h. New joiner exempt from PhishSim for first 7 days.
Rae (People Ops): I've DM'd the loaner pickup options and the BYOD waiver PDF (BYOD-2026-2). Noah — once you have the loaner, enroll it in Jamf and confirm FileVault: run `fdesetup status` in Terminal.
Noah Patel: Got the DM, thanks. Will wait for courier and won't clone repos until loaner arrives. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
